# opnsense_quagga_ospf6_prefixlist (Resource)

Manages one OPNsense OSPFv3 prefix-list entry.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the prefix list.
- `network` (String) Network prefix matched by this entry.
- `sequence_number` (Number) Sequence number used to order this prefix-list entry (10-99).

### Optional

- `action` (String) Whether matching routes are permitted or denied. Defaults to `permit`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether to enable this prefix-list entry. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the prefix-list entry.
